Question 2
?

Consider the curve r(t)=3ti+2t3/2j+4k, t≥0, for which the arc length from r(0) to r(t) is given by s=2(1+t)3/2−2. Given that R(s) is the parameterization of the given curve by its arc length s, what is the y-component of R?

a
 [(s2+1)3/2−1]3/2
b
 2[(s2+1)2/3−1]3/2
c
 2[(s2+1)1/3−1]3/2
d
 3(s2+1)3/2
e
 2[(s2−1)1/3+1]3/2
Submit
